                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Checked by hand

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • How it fooled us on 4 Nov: the company renamed its X from @cubecomputer_ to @collabs_inc, someone took the free name (new account, made 3 Nov) and put this token's address in its bio. That address is gone from the bio now
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • cube.computer now links only x.com/collabs_inc (on 4 Nov it still linked x.com/cubecomputer_). The token still lists @cubecomputer_
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Read all of docs.cube.computer (54k characters incl. FAQ and billing): it never mentions a token, $CUBE, crypto, a wallet or Robinhood Chain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Real paid product: cloud computers for coding agents, $6 per vCPU a month, $25 free credit; paid by card through Stripe, not with the token
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The GitHub (collabs-inc/cube-releases) is only a feed of app downloads, no source code; the company (COLLAB, 47 repos) keeps its code elsewhere
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 5 Nov: the launch wallet 0xbe3c1c76... burned its whole first buy (7.2M CUBE) at 11:46 UTC on 4 Nov, 6 minutes after launch, and sold nothing. The selling came from other wallets
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Wrong on 4 Nov: we called it 'team launched it' from the @cubecomputer_ bio. The tell was already in our notes: the X account was 1 day old while the product and GitHub were much older, a sign of a name taken over, not a new product account
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • First 'scam coin' posts from @yiliush at 13:35 UTC on 4 Nov, about 2 hours after launch; @Paul_Rony posted 'Someone took the @cubecomputer_ handle' at 13:51
